description: Search Twitch channels/streamers by name or keyword. Returns matching channels with display name, the game they stream, whether they are live now, title, and thumbnail. Example: search_channels({ query: "ninja", live_only: true })

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Twitch credentials as CLIENT_ID:CLIENT_SECRET for higher limits; omit to use the shared Pipeworx key.

first.description: Number of channels to return (default 20, max 100)

live_only.description: If true, only return channels that are currently live.

query.description: Search query — channel/streamer name or keyword, e.g. "ninja", "valorant".

name: search_channels
title: Search Channels
